inputs.name: dispatchTaskAttempt.runner
inputs.description: A runner with a run(input) method that returns a promise for the provider result. Its reportedModel and usage values are read when building the attempt record.

inputs.name: dispatchTaskAttempt.input
inputs.description: The complete TaskRunInput, including its AbortSignal, passed unchanged to runner.run. Its provider, model, and intelligence seed the attempt record, and its model is the fallback for cost quoting when no reported model is available.

inputs.name: dispatchTaskAttempt.executions
inputs.description: The mutable TaskExecution list supplied by the caller. The function appends a success record or attempts a failure record when an error reaches its catch block.

outputs.name: dispatchTaskAttempt
outputs.description: Provider result fields with the run context used by the module completion stage. The success record is appended before this function returns.

errors.name: propagated error
errors.description: A value thrown while constructing analytics or processing the attempt rejects this call. A runner rejection is rethrown after a failed record is appended, unless constructing or appending that record throws a later value.
